interface.longDescription:
Slashbooks helps you handle your small business accounting through ChatGPT. Sync your business bank accounts, categorize transactions, close your books monthly, and prepare financial reports for your accountant. Ask questions about your finances and forecast cash flow.

Slashbooks gives ChatGPT a double-entry accounting system that handles the calculations and checks that entries balance. Built-in workflows guide the bookkeeping for different types of businesses, from recording daily transactions to preparing for month-end close.

Requires a Slashbooks Cloud account.
defaultPrompt: Update my books through September 30 and tell me what still needs review.
Import this September bank statement and reconcile it with the books.
Forecast cash for the next 13 weeks and explain the assumptions.
